sa_g7-sa129_symbol.desc: truck parking symbol S13 (P over a truck) at 260 %

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet G7-SA129-5 (advance sign, 2550 x 1800 in the register): two boards in one assembly — the blue sign 2550 x 1200 (R150, blue edge 30 + white border 30, sheet 60 / 30) above the white slogan plate 2550 x 600 (R100, white edge 10 + blue border 20, sheet 30 / 10), drawn 50 apart as on the sheet (the gap is not dimensioned; measured), so the file is 2550 x 1850 with the gap transparent. Blue sign: truck parking symbol S13 (P over a truck) at 260 %, 910 high, 145 from top and bottom — traced from the sheet's filled artwork; 400 m (numerals 200 E, unit 170 E lower case), ON and LEFT 200 E, white. Slogan plate: SURVIVE / THIS DRIVE 160 E blue. Legend placed from the sheet's filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (the sheet's chains were read for the series and heights): 400 200 E top 180 x 1382-1985; m 170 E top 210 x 2073-2249; ON 200 E top 500 x 1629-2004; LEFT 200 E top 819 x 1473-2161; SURVIVE 160 E blue top 1350 x 772-1778; THIS 160 E blue top 1589 x 622-1129; DRIVE 160 E blue top 1589 x 1250-1927. The sheet's lower blue plate with empty symbol boxes (supplementary services, where shown) is a template and is not drawn.
